B1d room theitalyplace (order 118, contrary room) reread: A1 note, 19 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (172 threads). Added: t01 T3-069 beside T3-005 (c0004, c0041, c0100, c0284: stop spending pixels on the Vespa, the French flag and the UK's flag and concentrate on the Italian one); t09 T3-050 beside T3-081 (c0124, c0136, c0137, c0295, c0296: jokes at the French over wine, trolling Germany and France with football dates). Two rule 0 lines. t08 (checking who changed the pixels, placed once in T3-087) holds five kinds, so it is bagged under T3-087 with T3-188, T3-170, T3-126 and T3-195: Italy's moderator telling the Empire 'there are some people mindlessly fixing the flag, we can't control them. You have our support!' (c0219), another moderator saying 'those random pixels of red it's not us' (c0235), TFLS and the Empire calling stray pixels rogues and randoms (c0142, c0358); defenders mistaking their own legionary for an attack (c0168, c0169); a truce called one agent's sham (c0048); the communists accused of breaking a pact (c0058, c0066). Bag checked, 0 problems. c0219 is the T3-188 doing (the B1c idea 'conceding placers ignore the plan') in a seventh room, held in a bag. Unnamed kinds in bags already written, which write4 will not write twice: t02 (bagged under T3-149) also holds T3-126 (c0032, 'you have acted unilaterally without consulting the party', and the thread where TFLS members say their representative does not speak for the sub) and T3-076 (c0138, a faction halting its own unauthorised logo: 'we still feel responsible for it'); t11 (bagged under T3-010) also holds T3-011 (c0244, c0293, joining the UK and Waldo against the Void). One-concept cases left: c0222 (an Empire member's alternate account against the Void, T3-088), c0245 (telling the UK that 'Forza Italia' is Berlusconi's party, T3-080), c0280 (overexpansion brings empires down, T3-042), c0195 (a Trieste, not another Fiume). National and political content read plainly: the war and pacts with r/TheFarLeftSide, called communists throughout; 'DESTROY ALL MUSSOLINIS' (c0108); whether a tricolour and a Roman legionary amount to fascist apology, against partisan resistance (c0209, c0211); the Savoy crest (c0125, c0131); Caporetto, the Piave and General Diaz; the Vatican flag refused (c0148). No new kind; the run is not reset.

Added: t04 T3-048 beside T3-001 and T3-095 (c0179, c0296, c0299, c0308, c0507, c0510: reacting to NZXT's Puck Man, a video-card flash drive, Newegg's laptop, PCGH's Titan Y and Razer's S.A.i.S.O., jokes the room did not stage); t05 T3-177 beside T3-002 and T3-016 (c0643 'i was helping changing it to a swastika a few hours ago', c0787 'It's the right side up, this swastika is the circle of life'); t11 T3-182 beside T3-063 (c0627, a moderator removing a post for 'linking the PC Master Race with racial supremacy or any kind of fascist ideologies'); t12 T3-192 beside T3-031 (c0889, 60 fps changed to 69; c1019, 'I was trying to change it to pcmasterrape'). Four rule 0 lines. The swastika strand read plainly: the room's logo was turned into a swastika several times (c0537, c0588, c0589, c0785, c0786); a member defended it as 'a symbol of peace' (c0644, t09, which holds three kinds already); members covered it with RGB (c0918, c0919); the moderators twice refused any link between the room's name and fascism (c0627, c0788). c0788 sits in t13, which holds three kinds; recorded here for B1e. One-concept cases left: c1012 ('It was probably mostly our people', t15), c0495 (removed canvas posts leaving few maintainers), c0956 (a bigger logo so it cannot be modified, T3-055), c0894 (respecting the JB17 tribute, T3-024); the Kekistan flag noted in the canvas reuse (c1070, c1081, c1098).
